values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the state:SC row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights consecutive, then 7 nights away. Same-day reservations go through the park (803-788-2706). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/sesqui/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/sesquicentennial/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Sesquicentennial State Park allows a maximum 14-day consecutive night stay'), read 2026-10-21; single-night phone waiver from AWH's firsthand report on the state:SC agency row

note: State park near Columbia; 30-acre park lake for paddling and fishing. Recreational camping only: 'Residential or long-term occupancy is not permitted.' --Claude
